limitations: Synthetic numerical state stress test; confidence/threshold proxies establish no task safety, performance, adaptation quality or deployment robustness.
EMA numeric updater is an independent harness rule; both arms emit one typed proposal per evidence item, not a production continuous-learning implementation.

Default effective_persona verifies signature presence only. Main traces use explicit harness authorization bypass and a presence-only sentinel for authorized human tightening; they do not measure cryptographic authenticity.

Parameterized skill floors and human ceilings are harness checks; production would_violate_floor is additionally called at floor .05. Production human ceiling is declared but not enforced by would_violate_floor.
EMAValidationBackend is real, but its supplied rates are synthetic empirical failure fractions, not temporal EMAs. Numeric EMA update and validation are separate factors.
No emitter, SQLite persistence, circuit notification delivery, bounded-log recovery, checkpoint, migration, replay, rollback, T2 or T3 coverage.
Rejected governance proposals remain in the harness history and count toward limits, matching aggregate_count; resolver-rejected/validation-rejected proposals do not enter history.
One-at-a-time ablations can be masked by remaining protections; results are conditional contrasts, not independent causal contributions or optimized parameters.
Bootstrap intervals quantify variation across this chosen synthetic seed distribution only; degenerate intervals are expected for deterministic gates; no multiplicity adjustment.

metric_definitions.applied: Number of applied evidence-driven proposals, excluding the initial-condition event.
metric_definitions.authorization_rejected: Number of proposals rejected by the resolver signature-presence gate before entering governance history.
metric_definitions.circuit_breaker: Number of proposals clamped by the production circuit predicate before the rate and floor checks.
metric_definitions.final_confidence: Final synthetic.skill confidence; T5 proposals affect other capabilities, so this remains at the initial value there.
metric_definitions.final_human_threshold: Final synthetic.action human-check threshold, with initial/default value 0.5.
metric_definitions.floor: Number of proposals blocked by the selected skill-confidence floor or the independent harness human-threshold ceiling.
metric_definitions.minimum_confidence: Minimum of the initial synthetic.skill confidence and the affected capability confidence after each applied proposal.
metric_definitions.rate_limit: Number of proposals clamped by the production per-kind rate predicate after passing the circuit check.
metric_definitions.total_variation: Sum over applied proposals of absolute changes in the affected capability confidence plus the synthetic.action human-check threshold.
metric_definitions.validation_rejected: Number of unsupported-capability proposals rejected by EMAValidationBackend before entering governance history.
